chars.W: WATCHER: an older village man wearing a brown wool djellaba with a pointed hood and a grey scarf, holding a long old wooden hunting rifle
chars.L: LEADER: a middle-aged village man wearing a dark green quilted jacket, a beige knit beanie and brown trousers
chars.G: GANG: men wearing black balaclava masks, black hoodies and dark jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside a dim room in a small mud-brick village (douar) at the foot of the Atlas mountains in Morocco, lit by one oil lamp. LEADER leans forward whispering seriously to three other village men sitting on low cushions in plain grey and blue djellabas, all huddled close, secretive mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, an empty quiet dirt street in a small mud-brick village (douar) at the foot of the Atlas mountains in Morocco, doors closed, an abandoned small guard fire with only ashes, calm and deserted, no people.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night on a flat mud roof in a small mud-brick village (douar) at the foot of the Atlas mountains in Morocco. WATCHER lies hidden behind the low roof wall, rifle beside him, watching the dark valley patiently, tired eyes, stars above.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, four GANG members walking quietly in a line along a rocky mountain path toward a small mud-brick village (douar) at the foot of the Atlas mountains in Morocco, carrying empty sacks and a crowbar, sneaky posture.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Very dark night with a thin crescent moon, the GANG members are dark silhouettes creeping between mud-brick houses of a small mud-brick village (douar) at the foot of the Atlas mountains in Morocco, barely visible, tense mood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night, WATCHER on the flat mud roof seen from behind his shoulder, peeking over the roof edge, wide surprised eyes, looking down at small shadowy masked figures in the dirt street below in a small mud-brick village (douar) at the foot of the Atlas mountains in Morocco.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night in a small mud-brick village (douar) at the foot of the Atlas mountains in Morocco: the GANG members split up, one approaches a wooden stable door with a crowbar, another crouches by a water-pump shed, another looks around nervously.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night on the flat mud roof in a small mud-brick village (douar) at the foot of the Atlas mountains in Morocco: WATCHER stands up and fires his long rifle straight up into the sky, a bright muzzle flash, mouth wide open shouting, dramatic moment.
